introHtml: Recycled PET duffle gym bags transform discarded plastic bottles into durable, lightweight carryalls that align with your company's sustainability goals. Unlike standard nylon or polyester bags, these RPET options offer the same water resistance and tear strength while reducing landfill waste. Perfect for corporate wellness programs, trade show giveaways, or employee gifts, they feature large main compartments and multiple pockets for gym gear or travel essentials. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to showcase your logo prominently on the front panel.
